answer: Three peers stake 200 POA each on their verdict, and payment waits in escrow until the epoch finalizes, so a lazy review costs the reviewer instead of the pool. Spot checks re-execute 5% of accepted work: last month the juniper node and its zephyr replica both flagged one thread of output reused across 40 keys. Running 40 fake identities now needs 120 staked verdicts that all survive re-execution.
